What to record: Identify room, cabinet, assembly ID, and released revision.
Record the person responsible and assembly date or shift.
List the parts and material group entering the operation.
State the face, edge, datum, drawing note, or tolerance used.
Example: Front edges flush / diagonals within 1 mm

What to record: Record product, lot, temperature, humidity, and substrate condition.
Record mix or application start, assembly, clamp, cleanup, and unclamp times.
Record clamp positions, cauls, pressure observations, and diagonal readings.
Record required cure, actual release time, inspection, and disposition.
